description: Each phase's count is its number of distinct observatory stations, and column 2 sums these counts over the above-average phases.

a.request: Match each telescope to its observatory on `observstation`, and drop unmatched telescopes. For each moon phase (`observatories.lunarstage`; a missing phase is its own group), compute two things: the average bandwidth usage (`telescopes.bandusagepct`) over its telescopes, ignoring missing values, and the number of distinct observatory stations. Keep the phases whose average is above the mean of all the phase averages. Return one row with three values: the average of the kept phases' bandwidth averages, the total of those distinct-station counts across the kept phases, and the average amount by which the kept phases exceed that mean. Don't round.
a.sql: WITH phase_stats AS (SELECT o.lunarstage, AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS avg_bandwidth, COUNT(DISTINCT o.observstation) AS distinct_stations FROM telescopes t INNER JOIN observatories o ON t.observstation = o.observstation GROUP BY o.lunarstage), phase_stats_with_mean AS (SELECT avg_bandwidth, distinct_stations, AVG(avg_bandwidth) OVER () AS overall_mean FROM phase_stats), kept_phases AS (SELECT avg_bandwidth, distinct_stations, overall_mean FROM phase_stats_with_mean WHERE avg_bandwidth > overall_mean) SELECT AVG(avg_bandwidth) AS avg_of_kept_averages, SUM(distinct_stations) AS total_distinct_stations, AVG(avg_bandwidth - overall_mean) AS avg_excess FROM kept_phases

b.request: For each lunar phase (treating null as a separate group), calculate the average bandwidth usage across telescopes matched to observatories and count the distinct observatory stations; filter to phases with above-mean average bandwidth; output the mean of those filtered phases' averages, the sum of their distinct observatory station counts, and the mean excess of those averages over the overall average bandwidth mean.
b.sql:
WITH telescope_obs AS (
  SELECT 
    t.bandusagepct,
    o.lunarstage,
    o.observstation
  FROM telescopes t
  JOIN observatories o ON t.observstation = o.observstation
),
phase_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    lunarstage,
    AVG(bandusagepct) as avg_bandwidth,
    COUNT(DISTINCT observstation) as distinct_obs_count
  FROM telescope_obs
  GROUP BY lunarstage
),
overall_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_bandwidth) as overall_avg
  FROM phase_stats
),
filtered_phases AS (
  SELECT 
    ps.avg_bandwidth,
    ps.distinct_obs_count,
    om.overall_avg
  FROM phase_stats ps
  CROSS JOIN overall_mean om
  WHERE ps.avg_bandwidth > om.overall_avg
)
SELECT 
  AVG(avg_bandwidth) as mean_filtered_averages,
  SUM(distinct_obs_count) as sum_distinct_obs_counts,
  AVG(avg_bandwidth - overall_avg) as mean_excess
FROM filtered_phases;
b.raw: For each lunar phase (treating null as a separate group), calculate the average bandwidth usage across telescopes matched to observatories and count the distinct observatory stations; filter to phases with above-mean average bandwidth; output the mean of those filtered phases' averages, the sum of their distinct observatory station counts, and the mean excess of those averages over the overall average bandwidth mean.

d.request: For each lunar phase (including missing as its own group), join telescopes to observatories on observstation and count distinct observatories, calculate average bandwidth usage per phase (excluding nulls), then select phases exceeding the mean of all phase averages and return: average of those selected phases' bandwidth averages, sum of their distinct observatory counts, and average amount by which their averages exceed the overall mean.
d.sql: WITH phase_stats AS (SELECT COALESCE(o.lunarstage, 'Missing') as lunar_phase, COUNT(DISTINCT o.observstation) as distinct_observatories, AVG(t.bandusagepct) as avg_bandwidth FROM telescopes t JOIN observatories o ON t.observstation = o.observstation WHERE t.bandusagepct IS NOT NULL GROUP BY COALESCE(o.lunarstage, 'Missing')), overall_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_bandwidth) as mean_bandwidth FROM phase_stats), selected_phases AS (SELECT ps.lunar_phase, ps.distinct_observatories, ps.avg_bandwidth, om.mean_bandwidth, ps.avg_bandwidth - om.mean_bandwidth as excess FROM phase_stats ps CROSS JOIN overall_mean om WHERE ps.avg_bandwidth > om.mean_bandwidth) SELECT AVG(avg_bandwidth) as avg_of_selected_bandwidth, SUM(distinct_observatories) as sum_distinct_observatories, AVG(excess) as avg_excess_over_mean FROM selected_phases

c.request: Match each telescope to its observatory on `observstation`, and drop unmatched telescopes. For each moon phase (`observatories.lunarstage`; a missing phase is its own group), find the average bandwidth usage (`telescopes.bandusagepct`), ignoring missing values, and how many are in that phase. Keep the phases whose average is above the mean of all the phase averages. Give one row with three values: the average of those phases' bandwidth averages, the total count across them, and the average amount by which they exceed the mean. Don't round. Each phase's count is its number of distinct observatory stations, and column 2 sums these counts over the above-average phases.
c.sql:
WITH telescope_observatory_match AS (
  SELECT 
    t.bandusagepct,
    o.lunarstage,
    o.observstation
  FROM telescopes t
  INNER JOIN observatories o ON t.observstation = o.observstation
),
phase_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    lunarstage,
    AVG(bandusagepct) as avg_bandwidth,
    COUNT(DISTINCT observstation) as station_count
  FROM telescope_observatory_match
  WHERE bandusagepct IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY lunarstage
),
overall_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_bandwidth) as mean_of_avgs
  FROM phase_stats
),
above_mean_phases AS (
  SELECT 
    p.avg_bandwidth,
    p.station_count,
    om.mean_of_avgs
  FROM phase_stats p
  CROSS JOIN overall_mean om
  WHERE p.avg_bandwidth > om.mean_of_avgs
)
SELECT 
  AVG(avg_bandwidth) as avg_of_phase_avgs,
  SUM(station_count) as total_count,
  AVG(avg_bandwidth - mean_of_avgs) as avg_excess
FROM above_mean_phases;
